title: Gaussian quadrant probability formula
statement: Let $G,H$ be independent standard real Gaussian random variables, and let $-1\le\rho\le1$. The probability that $G\le0$ and $\rho G+\sqrt{1-\rho^2}\,H\le0$ is $\frac12-\frac{\arccos(\rho)}{2\pi}$.
hypotheses_covered: $G,H$ are independent standard real Gaussian random variables
replaced: Let $G,H$ be independent standard real Gaussians and let $-1\le\rho\le1$. Then $\Pr[G\le0,\ \rho G+\sqrt{1-\rho^2}\,H\le0]=\tfrac12-\arccos(\rho)/(2\pi)$.
